title: Bootstrapping on CentOS 6.x is broken

labels.name: P1
labels.description: I'll work on this now. (Assignee required)

body:
commit a96369c1c66df624bbee0d9e1c7ad38fea55cd26 broke bootstrapping on CentOS, to get the test:

bazel test src/test/docker:test_cc_configure-centos6.7-fastbuild

(requires docker, found by bisecting)

The error message is:

ERROR: /opt/workspace/src/main/cpp/BUILD:14:1: C++ compilation of rule '//src/main/cpp:blaze_util' failed (Exit 1): gcc failed: error executing command 
  (exec env - \
    PATH=/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin \
    PWD=/proc/self/cwd \
  /opt/rh/devtoolset-2/root/usr/bin/gcc -U_FORTIFY_SOURCE -fstack-protector -Wall -B/opt/rh/devtoolset-2/root/usr/bin -B/usr/bin -Wunused-but-set-parameter -Wno-free-nonheap-object -fno-omit-frame-pointer '-std=c++0x' -MD -MF bazel-out/local-fastbuild/bin/src/main/cpp/_objs/blaze_util/src/main/cpp/blaze_util_posix.pic.d '-frandom-seed=bazel-out/local-fastbuild/bin/src/main/cpp/_objs/blaze_util/src/main/cpp/blaze_util_posix.pic.o' -fPIC -DBLAZE_OPENSOURCE -iquote . -iquote bazel-out/local-fastbuild/genfiles -iquote external/bazel_tools -iquote bazel-out/local-fastbuild/genfiles/external/bazel_tools -isystem external/bazel_tools/tools/cpp/gcc3 -fno-canonical-system-headers -Wno-builtin-macro-redefined '-D__DATE__="redacted"' '-D__TIMESTAMP__="redacted"' '-D__TIME__="redacted"' -c src/main/cpp/blaze_util_posix.cc -o bazel-out/local-fastbuild/bin/src/main/cpp/_objs/blaze_util/src/main/cpp/blaze_util_posix.pic.o).
src/main/cpp/blaze_util_posix.cc: In function 'bool blaze::UnlimitResource(int)':
src/main/cpp/blaze_util_posix.cc:749:71: error: expected ')' before 'PRIdMAX'
     fprintf(stderr, "Warning: failed to raise resource limit %d to %" PRIdMAX
                                                                       ^
src/main/cpp/blaze_util_posix.cc:751:28: warning: spurious trailing '%' in format [-Wformat=]
             strerror(errno));
                            ^
src/main/cpp/blaze_util_posix.cc:751:28: warning: too many arguments for format [-Wformat-extra-args]
INFO: Building complete.

(probably missing an include). Log from CI: http://ci.bazel.io/job/bazel-docker-tests/BAZEL_VERSION=latest,PLATFORM_NAME=docker/674/console

Unfortunately the docker tests have been deactivated by error and did not run for a long time, that's why we only found out now.
